clips.name: riso-glow
clips.alt: The dancer turning on a dark stage, original left and with Riso Glow right: a two-ink print of fine pink and deep indigo dots on a near-black stage, where her dress, skin and the lamp at the left edge bloom with a soft pink glow that swells and fades once
clips.caption: Left: original. Right: Riso Glow at its default settings, one full breath of the glow (about three seconds).

clips.name: riso-glow-presets
clips.alt: The dancer four times in a grid, moving in sync, each with one preset: Blacklight top left, violet and pink dots with a slowly breathing pink glow; Neon Sign top right, coral light on dark teal; Embers bottom left, an orange glow smouldering in a near-black print; Heartbeat bottom right, a red glow that beats fast on dark maroon
clips.caption: The four presets on the moving dancer, in sync.

clips.name: riso-glow-dot-size
clips.alt: The dancer with Riso Glow while Dot Size runs from 3 to 20 px and back: the fine print of pink and deep indigo dots coarsens into large round dots and the glow widens with them, then both shrink again; the current value is shown at the bottom left
clips.caption: Dot Size from 3 to 20 px and back.

clips.name: riso-glow-registration
clips.alt: The dancer with Riso Glow while Registration runs from 0 to 16 px and back: the pink and indigo prints slide apart until pink fringes stand beside every edge, and come together again; the current value is shown at the bottom left
clips.caption: Registration from 0 to 16 px and back.

clips.name: riso-glow-glow
clips.alt: The dancer with Riso Glow while Glow runs from 0 to 2 and back at Speed 0: a plain two-ink print on a dark stage starts to shine pink around her dress, skin and the lamp, the glow blooms strongly and fades again; the current value is shown at the bottom left
clips.caption: Glow from 0 to 2 and back, at Speed 0 so the pulse holds still.

clips.name: riso-glow-speed
clips.alt: The dancer with Riso Glow at three speeds, about two seconds each: at Speed 0 the glow holds steady, at 2 it swells and fades a little more than once, at 4 it pulses twice as fast; the speed is shown at the bottom left
clips.caption: Speed 0, 2 and 4, about two seconds each (one breath lasts about 3.1 s ÷ Speed).

clips.name: riso-glow-amount
clips.alt: The dancer with Riso Glow while Amount runs from 0 to 1 and back: the original stage picture turns into the glowing pink and deep indigo print and back again; the current value is shown at the bottom left
clips.caption: Amount from 0 to 1 and back.
